_task_classification_guidance.binary: Pass/fail tasks. Must be done correctly regardless of QT. Single production rate. Examples: dust surface, apply primer, remove tape.
_task_classification_guidance.qt_conditional: Tasks that only appear in certain quality tiers. Examples: inspection rounds (QT4/QT5 only), between-coat sanding (QT4/QT5).
_task_classification_guidance.qt_scaled: Tasks in all tiers but production rate varies. Higher QT = slower pace, more scrutiny. Examples: cut-in, rolling finish coats.

_protection_metadata_guidance.purpose: Enables project-level optimization of protection setup/teardown across multiple specs
_protection_metadata_guidance.when_to_use: Add to all tasks with task_type 'protect'
_protection_metadata_guidance.method_dependent: Set to true when zone selection varies by spray vs brush/roll application

_adjacency_metadata_guidance.purpose: Enables finish continuity optimization when adjacent surfaces share the same finish
_adjacency_metadata_guidance.when_to_use: Add to edge-related tasks: masking at junctions, cut-in, blend tasks
_adjacency_metadata_guidance.skip_when: Task can be skipped when condition is met (e.g., same_finish_group)
_adjacency_metadata_guidance.required_when: Task is mandatory when condition is met (mutually exclusive with skip_when)
_adjacency_metadata_guidance.blend_tasks: Blend tasks must specify application_method: brush_roll
